name: Quote Chase Desk
tagline: Chases a trades shop's open quotes with approval-gated follow-up drafts
description: Made for trades businesses, it holds a live list of estimates still awaiting an answer and writes follow-up nudges on a patient, spaced rhythm, with every message waiting for your sign-off before anything leaves. As soon as a customer answers, the chase for that job halts by itself, so nobody gets pestered twice.
author: AraXsuper
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
